name: pdt
description: Run a Python or PowerShell script that works on your computer on a schedule in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Windows Task Scheduler, with the pdt command-line tool.

interface.longDescription: Checks, runs, and deploys a Python or PowerShell script as a scheduled job on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Windows Task Scheduler with the pdt command-line tool. Shows the plan and a monthly cost estimate before it deploys.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run this script every morning in my cloud account.
